name: Bismuth Android
description: Android ARM64 performance monitor with a compact top-left HUD, scene-owned safe update controller, frame analysis, CPU, best-effort GPU, thermal and renderer telemetry.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostic logging
diagnostics.description: Write Bismuth safe-mode initialization information to the Geode log.

hud-enabled.name: Live performance HUD
hud-enabled.description: Show a compact translucent top-left overlay with prominent FPS, frame time, CPU/GPU usage bars and optional memory details.

hud-advanced.name: Advanced frame analysis
hud-advanced.description: Show frame P50/P95/P99, estimated 1% low, HUD controller CPU wall time P50/P95/P99, hitch count, and sample count. This is game-loop timing, not display-present FPS.

hud-graph.name: Frame cadence graph
hud-graph.description: Show a rolling 24-sample frame cadence graph in Advanced Frame Analysis.

monitor-cpu.name: Measure game CPU usage
monitor-cpu.description: Sample this game's process CPU time from /proc/self/stat. The percentage is normalized across online CPU cores.

monitor-gpu.name: Measure GPU usage
monitor-gpu.description: Try cumulative GPU busy/total counters exposed by the Android devfreq driver (including supported Mali drivers). Shows N/A when the kernel does not expose readable counters.

monitor-thermal.name: Measure CPU/GPU temperature
monitor-thermal.description: Search readable thermal-zone type names for CPU and GPU sensors. OEM sensor labels vary; unavailable readings show N/A.

hud-memory.name: Process memory (RSS)
hud-memory.description: Show resident memory for the whole game process from /proc/self/statm; this is not native-heap-only memory.

shizuku-bridge-enabled.name: Shizuku telemetry bridge
shizuku-bridge-enabled.description: Receive device CPU/GPU/thermal and system RAM telemetry from Bismuth Companion over localhost. Start the companion bridge before launching gameplay.

renderer-telemetry.name: SpriteBatch renderer telemetry
renderer-telemetry.description: Count real CCSpriteBatchNode draw invocations and child nodes and measure CPU time spent in each batch draw call. This is CPU submission time, not GPU execution time.
